description_en: Views the information about MaxCompute internal tables, views, external tables, clustered tables, or transactional tables
description_zh: 查看MaxCompute内部表、视图、外部表、聚簇表或Transactional表的信息
kebab_example: aliyun maxcompute get-table-info --project-name odps_project --table-name sale_detail --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetTableInfo

parameters.help_en: The name of the project to which the table or view belongs
parameters.help_zh: 待查看表或视图的所属项目名称
parameters.name: project_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the schema to which the table or view belongs
parameters.help_zh: 待查看表或视图的所属Schema名称
parameters.name: schema_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the table or view that you want to view
parameters.help_zh: 待查看表或视图的名称
parameters.name: table_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the table or view that you want to view. Valid values:

internal: internal table

external: external table

view: view

materializedView: materialize view (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/maxcompute/user-guide/materialized-view-operations)
parameters.help_zh:
待查看表或视图的类型。取值：
internal：内部表。
external：外部表。
view：视图。
materializedView：<props="china">物化视图 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/maxcompute/user-guide/materialized-view-operations)</props>
<props="intl">物化视图 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/maxcompute/user-guide/materialized-view-operations)</props>
parameters.name: type

autoRefreshEnabled.description_en: Indicates whether the materialized view is automatically refreshed. This response parameter is returned when type is set to materializedView
autoRefreshEnabled.description_zh: 是否开启自动刷新物化视图，当类型为物化视图时有此返回值

clusterInfo.description_en: The clustering attribute. This response parameter is returned when the table is a clustered table
clusterInfo.description_zh: 聚簇属性，当表类型为聚簇表时有此返回值

bucketNum.description_en: Optional. The number of buckets in the clustered table. The value 0 indicates that the number of buckets dynamically changes when a job is running
bucketNum.description_zh: 可选字段，Cluster表的Bucket数目，0表示作业执行时动态决定

clusterType.description_en:
The clustering type of the table. MaxCompute supports hash clustering (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/maxcompute/use-cases/hash-clustering) and

range clustering (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/maxcompute/use-cases/range-clustering)
clusterType.description_zh:
表的聚簇（Clustering）类型，MaxCompute当前支持<props="china">Hash Clustering (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/maxcompute/use-cases/hash-clustering)</props>
<props="intl">Hash Clustering (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/maxcompute/use-cases/hash-clustering)</props> 和
<props="china"> Range Clustering (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/maxcompute/use-cases/hash-clustering)</props>
<props="intl">Range Clustering (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/maxcompute/use-cases/range-clustering)</props>两种类型

sortCols.description_en: The condition by which the results are sorted

items.description_en: The condition by which the results are sorted

name.description_en: The name of the sorting field

createTableDDL.description_en: DDL statement to create a table
createTableDDL.example: create table if not exists sale_detail( shop_name STRING, customer_id STRING, total_price DOUBLE) partitioned by (sale_date STRING, region STRING);

fileNum.description_en: The number of file of the table

isExternalTable.description_en: Indicates whether the table is an external table. This response parameter is returned when type is set to external
isExternalTable.description_zh: 是否为外部表，当类型为表时有此返回值

isOutdated.description_en: Indicates whether data of the materialized view is invalid due to changes in the data of the source table. This response parameter is returned when type is set to materializedView
isOutdated.description_zh: 是否因为源表数据有变化，导致物化视图数据无效，当类型为物化视图时有此返回值

lastAccessTime.description_en: The time when data of the table or view was last accessed
lastAccessTime.description_zh:
表或视图的数据最后访问时间，当表为非分区表时有此返回值。
该数据从2023年7月陆续升级采集，在升级后没有被访问过或者通过ALGO作业、Hologres直读方式访问的无法采集到last_access_time

lastDDLTime.description_en: The time when the data definition language (DDL) statement of the table or view was last modified
lastDDLTime.description_zh: 表或视图的DDL最后变更时间

lastModifiedTime.description_en: The time when data of the table or view was last modified
lastModifiedTime.description_zh: 表或视图的数据最后变更时间

location.description_en: The path of the external table. This response parameter is returned when type is set to external
location.description_zh: 外部表地址，当类型为外部表时有此返回值

materializedView.description_en: Indicates whether the table or view is a materialize view (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/maxcompute/user-guide/materialized-view-operations)
materializedView.description_zh:
是否为<props="china">物化视图 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/maxcompute/user-guide/materialized-view-operations)</props>
<props="intl">物化视图 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/maxcompute/user-guide/materialized-view-operations)</props>

name.description_en: The name of the table or view

label.description_en: The sensitivity-level label of the column. For more information, see Label-based access control (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/maxcompute/user-guide/label-based-access-control)
label.description_zh:
列的敏感等级标签。更多信息请参见<props="china">Label权限控制 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/maxcompute/user-guide/label-based-access-control)</props>
<props="intl">Label权限控制 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/maxcompute/user-guide/label-based-access-control)</props>

odpsPropertiesRolearn.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the role AliyunODPSDefaultRole in Resource Access Management (RAM). This response parameter is returned when type is set to external
odpsPropertiesRolearn.description_zh: RAM 中 AliyunODPSDefaultRole 的 ARN 信息，当类型为外部表时有此返回值

odpsSqlTextOptionFlushHeader.description_en: Indicates whether the table header is ignored. This response parameter is returned when type is set to external
odpsSqlTextOptionFlushHeader.description_zh: 是否忽略表头，当类型为外部表时有此返回值

odpsTextOptionHeaderLinesCount.description_en: The first N rows that were ignored in the table header. This response parameter is returned when type is set to external
odpsTextOptionHeaderLinesCount.description_zh: 忽略表头前N行，当类型为外部表时有此返回值

owner.description_en: The account information of the table or view owner
owner.description_zh: 表或视图的所有者账号信息

partitionColumns.description_en: The information about partition key columns. This response parameter is returned only for partitioned tables
partitionColumns.description_zh: 分区列信息，分区表才有此返回值

items.description_en: The information about the partition key column

comment.description_en: The comments of the partition key column

label.description_en: The sensitivity-level label of the column. For more information, see Label-based access control (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/maxcompute/user-guide/label-based-access-control)
label.description_zh:
列的敏感等级标签。更多信息请参见<props="china">Label权限控制 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/maxcompute/user-guide/label-based-access-control)</props>
<props="intl">Label权限控制 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/maxcompute/user-guide/label-based-access-control)</props>

physicalSize.description_en: The physical size of the table

projectName.description_en: The name of the project to which the table or view belongs
projectName.description_zh: 表或视图的所属项目名称

rewriteEnabled.description_en: Indicates whether the query rewrite operation can be performed by using the materialized view. This response parameter is returned when type is set to materializedView
rewriteEnabled.description_zh: 是否允许通过物化视图执行查询改写操作，当类型为物化视图时有此返回值

schema.description_en: The name of the schema to which the table or the view belongs

size.description_en: The data size of the non-partitioned table. If the table is a partitioned table, the system does not calculate the data size of the table. In this case, the value of this parameter is NULL. The PARTITIONS view includes the data size of each partition in a partitioned table. Unit: bytes
size.description_zh: 如果表为非分区表，值为表的数据量大小。如果表为分区表，系统不会计算表的数据量大小，值为NULL。PARTITIONS视图中包含分区表各个分区的数据量大小。单位：字节（Byte）

storageHandler.description_en: The storage handler of the external table. This response parameter is returned when type is set to external
storageHandler.description_zh: 外部表解析器，当类型为外部表时有此返回值

tableLabel.description_en: The sensitivity-level label of the table. For more information, see Label-based access control (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/maxcompute/user-guide/label-based-access-control)
tableLabel.description_zh:
表的敏感等级标签。更多信息请参见<props="china">Label权限控制 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/maxcompute/user-guide/label-based-access-control)</props>
<props="intl">Label权限控制 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/maxcompute/user-guide/label-based-access-control)</props>

tablesotreTableName.description_en: The name of the Tablestore table to be accessed. This response parameter is returned when type is set to external
tablesotreTableName.description_zh: 需要访问的 Tablestore 表名称，当类型为外部表时有此返回值

tablestoreColumnsMapping.description_en: The columns of the Tablestore table to be accessed, including the primary key column and attribute column. This response parameter is returned when type is set to external
tablestoreColumnsMapping.description_zh: 描述 MaxCompute 将访问的 Tablestore 表的列，包括主键和属性列，当类型为外部表时有此返回值

type.description_en:
The type of the table or view. Valid values:

internal: internal table

external: external table

view: view

materializedView: materialize view (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/maxcompute/user-guide/materialized-view-operations)
type.description_zh:
表或视图类型。取值：
internal：内部表。
external：外部表。
view：视图。
materializedView：<props="china">物化视图 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/maxcompute/user-guide/materialized-view-operations)</props>
<props="intl">物化视图 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/maxcompute/user-guide/materialized-view-operations)</props>

viewText.description_en: The statement that generates the view. This response parameter is returned when type is set to view
viewText.description_zh: 生成视图的语句，当类型为视图时有此返回值
viewText.example: select shop_name, sum(total_price) from sale_detail group by shop_name
